theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let S := k
  haveI : IsAlgebraic ℚ (↑0 : ↥S) := by apply_instance
  haveI : IsAlgebraic ℚ (↑1 : ↥S) := by apply_instance
  exact IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_iff { K := ℚ } { L := K } { S := S }
